_comment: SCHEMA ONLY. Every value is a <placeholder> describing the field, not an example of one. build.py refuses any file that still contains _comment or a <placeholder>. Omit optional fields the pipeline did not produce. Every section and every comparison dimension carries 'available'; when it is false, the only other key is 'reason_if_unavailable'.

track.code: <participant code, e.g. p01; real names live only in the private vault>
track.pipeline: <string: tool and version that produced the analysis>
track.notes: <string, optional: anything unusual about this run>

harmony.key_confidence: <number 0-1: the primary profile's key strength. Not a probability.>

section_endings.degree: <scale degree sounding as the section ends>

key_reading.ambiguous: <true when more than one reading is listed>

chord_changes.degree: <scale degree of the root triad, per CLAUDE.md, or N>
chord_changes.detail: <optional, Chordino or Moises: what the label adds, e.g. 7, maj7, 6>
chord_changes.bass_degree: <optional, Chordino or Moises: scale step of a slash-chord bass, e.g. I>
chord_changes.strength: <number 0-1, Essentia only: detector's chord strength; never shown on the page>

chord_source.beyond_coverage: <plain-language reason, required when the chords stop before the track ends>

beat_confidence.scale_max: <number: top of the tool's confidence scale>

matches.source: <McGill Billboard (harmony and structure) | Harmonix (structure only; harmony unavailable)>
matches.title: <string>
matches.year: <integer, optional: omit if the corpus does not give it>
matches.overall_similarity: <number 0-1: only when two or more dimensions are available>
